method: Computed text RGB versus three rendered background pixels along each element top line-box edge, inside the empty leading space above glyphs. Dominant rectangle colors are retained as diagnostics; they can equal glyph ink when backgrounds vary pixel by pixel. PNG pixels already include alpha, gradients, blur, and shadows. Edge and padding samples in rendered-checks.json provide additional local evidence. No all-pixel or state-wide certification.
